observation: The current Vapor test has paused or failed Halo, Witcher 3 and Skyrim jobs in the app-private wine11-games registry, while the main-drive registry still contains only the earlier completed Blackjack download.
cause: The UI build generated the bridge-only startup because WINE11_EXPERIMENT_GAME_HOST was not set. That startup uses the private-storage default and does not start the dedicated game host. The packager did not previously verify the dedicated startup.
remediation: Generate the dedicated startup explicitly and refuse to assemble a test title without the main-drive anchor and dedicated host. Rebuild and verify on the console. Do not automatically delete or migrate the private partial downloads.
